scenario_type: Privileged Insider + Data Staging + Personal Cloud Upload
investigation_objective: Determine whether large after-hours finance data movement is legitimate business activity, negligent policy violation, or malicious insider exfiltration requiring escalation.

likely_adversary_objective.summary: Remove sensitive finance data from corporate controls before it can be reviewed or blocked.
likely_adversary_objective.attack_style: Trusted insider data exfiltration / policy evasion

alerts.title: Large Upload to Personal Cloud Storage
alerts.description: User uploaded a large encrypted archive to a personal Dropbox account from a finance workstation.
evidence: Transfer occurred outside normal working hours
alerts.why_it_matters: Large uploads of sensitive finance archives to personal cloud storage may indicate data exfiltration or policy violation.

alerts.title: Sensitive Finance Folder Bulk Access
alerts.description: User accessed and copied a large number of files from restricted finance folders.
evidence: Folders accessed: M&A Planning, Payroll Forecast, Board Reporting
482 files opened or copied within 18 minutes
Volume exceeds normal peer group activity
Access occurred after normal work hours
alerts.why_it_matters: Bulk access to sensitive folders is a common precursor to insider exfiltration.

alerts.title: Encrypted Archive Created
alerts.description: User created a password-protected ZIP archive containing sensitive finance documents.
evidence: Archive staged in local Downloads folder
alerts.why_it_matters: Encrypted archive creation can be legitimate, but in this sequence it supports staging for exfiltration.

alerts.title: USB Storage Device Inserted
alerts.description: A removable USB storage device was inserted and received a copy of the staged finance archive.
evidence: Device not previously seen on this endpoint
Copy occurred 16 minutes before cloud upload
alerts.why_it_matters: USB copy creates an additional possible exfiltration path and strengthens intent concerns.

alerts.title: Forwarding Rule to Personal Email Attempted
alerts.description: User attempted to create an inbox forwarding rule to a personal email address; policy blocked the action.
evidence: Rule condition: messages with attachments from Finance Leadership
No prior forwarding-rule creation by this user
alerts.why_it_matters: Attempted forwarding of finance attachments to personal email indicates possible data leakage intent.

alerts.title: Local Staging Files Deleted
alerts.description: User deleted the staged archive and temporary export folder after upload completion.
evidence: Deletion occurred 8 minutes after Dropbox upload completed
alerts.why_it_matters: Cleanup after external upload may indicate concealment or intentional policy evasion.

threat_context.threat_summary: This case does not resemble classic malware-driven intrusion. It more strongly matches insider-threat exfiltration: authorized access, abnormal collection, archive staging, personal cloud upload, USB copy, and cleanup behavior.

observed_evidence: 482 sensitive files accessed and copied within 18 minutes

mitre_attack_mapping.technique_name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
observed_evidence: Password-protected 7-Zip archive created from staged finance files
2.8 GB uploaded to personal Dropbox account
Same archive copied to newly observed USB storage device
Staging folder and archive deleted; recycle bin cleared

detection_recommendation.detection_goal: Detect sensitive data staging followed by personal cloud upload, USB copy, or personal email forwarding within a short time window.
tuning_recommendations: Require correlation with sanctioned-vs-unsanctioned destination classification before high-severity escalation.
Raise severity for personal cloud, USB write, or personal email forwarding within 60 minutes.
